reason: Rejeitar is basic, transparent vocabulary, while the more marked manners of rejection are taught by the retained rebuff and repudiate cards.
Policy revision motivates rever rather than an automatic revisar and teaches the useful distinction between reconsidering and structurally reformulating something.
The intensive-examination sense requires an explicit marker such as minuciosamente and distinguishes scrutiny from a merely general examination.
Sublinhar, ressaltar, and frisar are familiar C1 emphasis verbs, and an earlier highlight item was already dropped for the same lack of distinctive teaching value.
Afirmar is a transparent, high-frequency analytical verb, and the isolated prompt selects no legal, performative, or emphatic sense.
The card teaches cautious attribution and the important fact that alegar does not by itself declare an allegation false.
Giving additional support to a thesis is a useful collocation, and the evidential force must not be overstated as definitive proof.
Levantar uma questão captures introducing a topic and narrows legacy abordar, which can imply treating the issue at length.
Contornar and eludir teach regulatory avoidance while allowing a useful distinction from the more explicitly accusatory burlar.
The rare English verb adds no Portuguese production lesson beyond the retained contemplate card, whose main rendering is already cogitar.
The formal evidential verb usefully distinguishes converging support from definitive proof and provides a precise research and investigative collocation.
The argumentative-response sense motivates rebater and contrasts with contrapor, which normally relates one position or element to another.
Deduzir is a transparent academic equivalent, and the preceding batch already retains infer with its evidential government and implication contrast.
A restrained objection requires fazer uma objeção or manifestar uma ressalva and materially corrects legacy desmentir.
The malformed legacy gloss needs a production-ready rendering, and desqualificar teaches disparagement without automatically importing the narrower force of defamation.
Ridicularizar is a familiar, direct equivalent at C1, and the bare prompt provides no distinct construction beyond ordinary public mockery.
The card marks discernir as formal, contrasts it with the more current identificar, and fixes perception of a subtle pattern rather than decision-making.
Institutional information distribution motivates the more natural divulgar and distinguishes it from the more technical cognate disseminar.
Portuguese selects different verbs by object: reactions are suscitated, while information is obtained or brought out.
The figurative narrative sense goes beyond literal beautification and can convey favorable exaggeration without necessarily asserting wholesale fabrication.
Defender or adotar a position adds no distinct Portuguese lesson beyond the preceding batch's retained advocate, champion, and embrace cards.
The deceptive sense motivates forjar and distinguishes fabricated evidence from ordinary physical manufacturing.
The nonliteral sense requires compreender plenamente and materially corrects legacy sondar, which imports the depth-measurement metaphor.
Depreender de and extrair de teach government and the nuance of obtaining limited information from indirect documentary evidence.
The idiomatic discourse sense requires bater sempre na mesma tecla and completely corrects the broken literal legacy rendering.
Questioning credibility calls for pôr em dúvida, while Portuguese impugnar strongly favors formal challenges to acts or decisions.
Incutir algo em alguém provides a productive Brazilian headword and teaches the argument order and governed preposition omitted by the legacy cognate.
A jurisdiction-neutral formal-accusation paraphrase avoids equating indictment with conviction or with any single Brazilian procedural stage.
Insinuar is a transparent, familiar argumentative cognate, and the bare prompt does not select indirect suggestion, infiltration, or gradual insertion.
Elogiar is the natural journalistic rendering, while legacy laudar is markedly rare or specialized in contemporary Brazilian usage.
Reflecting or pondering adds no distinct production lesson beyond the preceding retained ponder card; the negatively repetitive ruminate remains distinct here.
Opinar is a familiar, high-frequency Portuguese verb, and the bare source supplies no construction that would justify another opinion card.
Postular is a transparent academic cognate, and the preceding batch already teaches the same premise-setting sense through the retained posit card.
The legal term has real teaching value because approval, sanction, promulgation, and publication name distinct legislative acts.
Rechaçar preserves a firm rejection without automatically importing the unsupported discourtesy of recusar bruscamente.
Recapitular is a transparent and familiar discourse verb whose ordinary transitive use offers no new construction at C1.
Refutar teaches the evidential requirement that distinguishes proving a claim false from merely denying, rejecting, or contesting it.
Reafirmar is natural for restating a position, while reiterar is more administrative and creates a useful warning against redundant novamente.
Repudiar teaches categorical public rejection and often signals moral or political disassociation, unlike the basic reject item.
Remoer captures repetitive, often brooding thought and remains distinct from the neutral deliberation already taught by contemplate and ponder.
